name: harness-dashboard-vscode
description: See, check and price the AI agent harness you already have: agents, skills, rules and their relationships, in any supported format or your own layout.

commands.title: Sync Harness SDD Agents from Filesystem

harness-dashboard.adapters.claude-code.p.description: Path to the Claude Code agent configuration directory (workspace-relative).

harness-dashboard.adapters.claude-code.d.description: Discover Claude Code hook and steering files. Overrides: .harness-dashboard/config.json.

harness-dashboard.adapters.cursor.path.description: Path to the Cursor agent configuration directory (workspace-relative).

harness-dashboard.adapters.cursor.discov.description: Discover Cursor hook and steering files. Overrides: .harness-dashboard/config.json.

harness-dashboard.adapters.gemini-cli.pa.description: Path to the Gemini CLI agent configuration directory (workspace-relative).

harness-dashboard.adapters.gemini-cli.di.description: Discover Gemini CLI hook and steering files. Overrides: .harness-dashboard/config.json.

harness-dashboard.adapters.copilot.path.description: Path to the GitHub Copilot instructions directory (workspace-relative). The .vscode/prompts/ directory is unaffected by this setting.

harness-dashboard.adapters.copilot.disco.description: Discover Copilot hook and steering files. Overrides: .harness-dashboard/config.json.

harness-dashboard.adapters.windsurf.path.description: Path to the Windsurf rules directory (workspace-relative).

harness-dashboard.adapters.windsurf.disc.description: Discover Windsurf hook and steering files. Overrides: .harness-dashboard/config.json.

harness-dashboard.adapters.kiro.path.description: Path to the Kiro agent configuration directory (workspace-relative).

harness-dashboard.adapters.kiro.discover.description: Discover Kiro hook and steering files. Overrides: .harness-dashboard/config.json.

harness-dashboard.discovery.root.description: Scan <workspace-root>/hooks/ and <workspace-root>/steering/ for hook/steering files regardless of which adapters are detected. Disable if they live only under tool-specific folders.

harness-dashboard.ai.apiKey.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible fallback provider (R5). When empty, the fallback is disabled and only vscode.lm is tried.

harness-dashboard.ai.endpoint.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible chat completions API (R5). Change to use a different provider (e.g. Ollama, LM Studio, Azure OpenAI).

harness-dashboard.ai.model.description: Model identifier for the OpenAI-compatible API (R5). Sent as the 'model' field in the request body.

harness-dashboard.optimizer.enabled.description: Enable the Component Optimizer: scores agent, skill, steering and hook files against the rules their format supports.

harness-dashboard.optimizer.tokenBudget..description: Fallback token budget for a skill, used only when the workspace has fewer than 5 skills. Above that, budgetMedianMultiple x the corpus median applies.
Fallback token budget for a subagent or agent file, used only when the workspace has fewer than 5 of that type.
Fallback token budget for a steering file, used only when the workspace has fewer than 5 steering files.
Estimated token budget for an agent plus everything it reaches over 'uses' and 'governs' edges. Exceeding it raises OPT-B03.

harness-dashboard.optimizer.overlapThres.description: TF-IDF cosine similarity at or above which two same-typed components are reported as overlapping (OPT-O01). Lower values report more pairs.

harness-dashboard.optimizer.disabledRule.description: Optimizer rule IDs to skip entirely, e.g. ["OPT-H03", "OPT-O02"]. Disabled rules contribute no findings and no score deduction.

harness-dashboard.optimizer.budgetMedian.description: Multiple of the median same-typed component above which OPT-B01/OPT-B02 report a component as unusually large. Used from 5 components of that type and owner; below that the absolute tokenBudget values apply.

harness-dashboard.optimizer.assistedFixe.description: Offer AI Refine (reviewed in a diff before writing) and Delegate (a terminal agent edits files directly, no preview) on findings.

harness-dashboard.cost.prices.markdownDescription: Optional price table for cost estimates: `date` and `models` (`inputPerMTok`, optional `family`). No prices ship or are fetched; estimates show the date.

harness-dashboard.cost.calibration.markdownDescription: Optional calibration factor per model family, applied only to money estimates for that family.

enumDescriptions: Offer both AI Refine and Delegate.
Offer only AI Refine, which always previews its proposal in a diff before writing.
Offer only delegation to a terminal agent. Note that this mode has no diff preview.
harness-dashboard.optimizer.assistedFixe.description: Which assisted fix modes to offer.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a folder to see the agent harness it contains.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
Scanning the workspace for agent harnesses…

No agent harness found. Supported formats are detected automatically; for another layout, [declare a harness profile](command:harness-dashboard.openLocalConfig). Learn how in [Bring Your Own Harness](https://github.com/marcmassa/harness-manager/blob/main/docs/byoh/v0.9.0.md).

The last scan failed; details are in the Harness Dashboard output.
[Refresh](command:harness-dashboard.refresh)
No findings for the detected harness.
Findings appear here once a harness has been scanned. [Refresh](command:harness-dashboard.refresh)

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Harness Dashboard
walkthroughs.description: See, check and price the agent harness you already have, in any supported format or your own.

steps.title: Open the Dashboard
steps.description:
Supported formats are detected automatically. The whiteboard, Advisory, Optimizer and timeline open in an editor tab.
[Open the Dashboard](command:harness-dashboard.openDashboard)

media.altText: A graph of agents and skills

steps.title: Review detected sources
steps.description:
Sources lists every provider found and each file it owns.
[Show Sources](command:harness-dashboard.sources.focus)

media.altText: A list of providers and files

steps.title: Declare a profile for a custom layout
steps.description:
Agents in your own folders? Describe them in a profile ([Bring Your Own Harness](https://github.com/marcmassa/harness-manager/blob/main/docs/byoh/v0.9.0.md)).
[Open Local Configuration](command:harness-dashboard.openLocalConfig)

steps.title: Review findings
steps.description:
Advisory and Optimizer results, grouped by owner.
[Show Findings](command:harness-dashboard.findings.focus)

steps.title: Explore context cost
steps.description:
See what each harness costs per session and what loads only on demand.
[Optimize Components](command:harness-dashboard.optimizeComponents)

media.altText: A bar chart of token cost

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies && bash scripts/vsix-gate.sh harness-dashboard-vscode-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").vsix
scripts.publish: npm run package && vsce publish --packagePath harness-dashboard-vscode-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").vsix
